macros.name: footbibliography
macros.doc: Defines the list of bibliographic databases for the foot bibliography.

macros.name: footbibliographystyle
macros.doc: Defines the style of the foot bibliography.

macros.name: footbibrule
macros.doc: The foot bibliography is separated from the rest of the page by a vertical skip of length \footbibskip in which a horizontal line is drawn by the command \footbibrule.

macros.name: footbibskip
macros.doc: The foot bibliography is separated from the rest of the page by a vertical skip of length \footbibskip in which a horizontal line is drawn by the command \footbibrule.

macros.name: footcite
macros.doc: It defines a command \footcite which is similar to the \cite command of LaTeX but the references cited in this way are inserted at the bottom of the pages.

macros.name: footcitelistformat
macros.doc: The macro \footcitelistformat defines the macros \fb@citestart, \fb@citesep and \fb@citeend used by \fb@cite to build the list of citations in the text.

macros.name: footnocite
macros.doc: Puts the reference at the bottom of the page but puts nothing in the text.

macros.name: footreflabel
macros.doc: The label of the reference is formated by the macro \footreflabel which takes the label as argument.

macros.name: footxref
macros.doc: The text of the cross-reference is generated by the command \footxref which takes two arguments: (1) the label and (2) the page of the last full citation.
